node.title: Re^3: Locating Chart::Gnuplot
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
sh: convert: command not found

convert is probably from [http://imagemagick.org/|ImageMagick]. On Windows you can use its installer, on *NIX systems I usually find it easiest to use the system's package manager, e.g. on Debian/Ubuntu sudo apt-get install imagemagick (or sudo apt-get install graphicsmagick-imagemagick-compat).
